name: react_app
description: Build a complete React application with Vite, Tailwind CSS, and React Router.
steps: Create project structure: src/components/, src/pages/, src/hooks/, src/utils/, public/
Write index.html with Vite entry point
Write package.json with react, react-dom, react-router-dom, vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, tailwindcss
Write src/App.jsx with React Router routes
Write each page component in src/pages/
Run: npm run build to verify no errors
best_practices: Use functional components and hooks only — no class components
Keep components small and focused (single responsibility)
Use React Router v6 with <Routes> and <Route>
Tailwind for all styling — no inline styles except dynamic values
Use useCallback and useMemo only when profiling shows a need
Group related state with useReducer for complex forms
Always handle loading and error states in data-fetching components
Name files with PascalCase for components, camelCase for utils

templates.tailwind.config.js: export default { content: ['./index.html','./src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}'], theme: { extend: {} }, plugins: [] }
templates.src/main.jsx:
import React from 'react'
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client'
import App from './App.jsx'
import './index.css'
ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<React.StrictMode><App /></React.StrictMode>)

system_prompt_injection: You are building a React application. Use Vite + React + Tailwind CSS. Create ALL files listed in the steps. Write complete, working code. After creating all files, run npm install then npm run build to verify. Fix any build errors before finishing.
